notes.title: Pretty World Quest Update and Button text overflow update

notes.title: Updated Mouse Targeting and Additional Dungeon Occlusion Optimizations
notes.content:
Mouse targeting has been improved in combat so that you can click the enemies after choosing your action. A sword icon will appear on and above the targeted enemy and you can left click to complete the action on that target. (You can still target using either of the old methods of clicking the enemy portrait in the targeting window or cycling through the targets using the previous target/next target buttons and clicking accept.)

Additional occlusion optimizations have been added in the dungeons to reduce CPU usage

notes.title: Culling system replacement
notes.content:
Replaced engine default culling system with new more performant system on outside islands. (This should provide much better fps increases than any other improvement so far.)
Added culling of objects inside buildings
Fixed dialogue bug in Sword in Stone

notes.title: Graphics and Optimization Update!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Faster Rendering Engine
[*] New Performant Water System
[*] New Performant Terrain Texturing System
[*] Shadow quality and rendering settings for improved performance
[*] [b]Additional Graphics Settings for improved frame rate on lower end systems[/b]
[/list]

[b]Gameplay improvement[/b]
[list]
[*] New equipment type: Wands
[*] Additional wands and rings available from several magic shops
[*] Additional items available that grant abilities to their user
[*] fps display toggle
[*] updated character creation to show primary attributes for classes during selection
[*] increased font size for racial attribute modifiers in character creation
[*] increased move range on several enemies to better match their aggressive sound announcements
[*] reduced enemy detection range on several enemies to better match their aggressive sounds
[/list]

[b]
Additional Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Inverse Camera Vertical option has changed and will need to be toggled back on for the new options system. (The default setting is off.)
[*] VSync options have changed. It may be turned on (limited refresh rate to the monitor) or off.
[*] Refresh rate choices may be selected from the new dropdown menu under graphics options.  
[/list]

[b]Additional Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] fixed bug causing slowdown on starting island
[*] fixed bug on description of cure all ability
[*] fixed animations on several combatants (orc, orc chief, dark elf, dark elf lord, Cerberus, earth titan)
[*] fixed chest rotation on merlins hat artifact
[*] fixed collision bug on statue in mine of murg level 2
[*] fixed bug in time of day system
[*] fixed dialogue error in warning fires quest
[*] fixed bug that sometimes caused the red crystal achievement to not work correctly
[*] fixed bug on teleport tooltips
[*] fixed bug on necromancer life steal ability
[/list]

notes.title: Less Jet Engine with frame limit options
notes.content:
-added fps limits to reduce game load. VSync defaults to on now (limits fps to monitor refresh rate). VSync rate may be changed in the settings. It can be set to On (equal to monitor refresh rate), Half (half monitor refresh rate), Quarter (1/4 monitor refresh rate) or Off (no frame limit).

Limiting the frames per second will have a significant impact if you are running at a really high frame rate. Rates over 60 are not really needed with this game.

My system with old settings would run at 70% CPU and about 50% GPU. Setting to VSync Half (72 fps for my monitors 144 hz) reduces the CPU load to about 45% and GPU load to about 35%.
